raw_response.subject: Request for Clarification Regarding EPR Certificates and Supporting Documentation
raw_response.opening_paragraph: We are writing to request clarification and supporting documentation regarding the EPR certificates issued for your operations. During our routine compliance review, we noted a few areas where the documented quantities require further reconciliation. We appreciate your cooperation in helping us ensure accurate reporting.

items.heading: Discrepancy in Inbound Shipment Quantities
items.what_we_observed: We observed that for one inbound shipment, the net weight recorded on the weighbridge slip is more than 2% below the quantity stated on the corresponding invoice.
items.what_we_request: Please provide clarification regarding this weight difference and any additional documentation, such as receiving reports or correspondence with the transporter, to explain the variance.

raw_response.closing_paragraph: Please submit the requested clarifications and supporting documents within 15 days of receiving this letter. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter and your continued commitment to compliance.

raw_response.subject: Clarification Request: EPR Certificate Verification
raw_response.opening_paragraph: We are writing to request clarification and supporting documentation regarding the EPR certificates issued. During our routine compliance review, we noted a few areas where additional information is required to align the records.

items.heading: Discrepancy in Shipment Weight Records
items.what_we_observed: We observed that 1 shipment has a weighbridge net weight that is more than 2% below the invoice quantity, as documented in the inbound invoice, e-way bill, and weighbridge slip.
items.what_we_request: Please provide clarification regarding this weight discrepancy and submit any supporting documentation to reconcile the invoice quantity with the weighbridge net weight.

raw_response.closing_paragraph: Please review these items and provide the requested clarifications and supporting documents within 15 days of this letter. Thank you for your cooperation in maintaining compliance standards.
